title: annot flow document
description: One skill's graph, as `annot annotate` writes it. This is the artifact every other command reads: `check` compares its anchors, `render` draws it, `context` slices it for an edit. A version field comes first because a reader that guesses the shape is a reader that silently misreads an old file.

schema_version.description: Bumped only for a breaking change to a field another command reads.

file.description: Path as the caller named it; relative when the caller was.

sha.description: sha256 of the whole SKILL.md. A change here means every anchor below may be meaningless.

phases.description: Columns the author declared, one per heading that names a stage (`Phase 1`, `阶段二`, `Step 3`). Empty when the skill declares none; the layout then falls back to pure sequence depth.

label.description: The heading text, trimmed to what a column header can hold.

byLane.description: Who performs each step. Orthogonal to `byType`: `git fetch` is a stage the tool runs, `判断分支是否落后` is a stage the reader runs.

anchor.description: A contiguous 1-based inclusive line range plus the hash of exactly those lines. The hash is the only staleness judge: a range that moved but whose bytes are identical is still current.

sha.description: sha256 of the exact lines in the range, joined with a newline. A range that moved but whose bytes are identical is current; a range whose bytes changed is stale, even at the same line numbers.

id.description: Unique within the document; a slug of the label, suffixed on collision. Never reassigned by an edit.

type.description: stage = a step, decision = a fork, gate = a rule that can stop the flow, artifact = an output shape, external = a call out of the skill.

subtitle.description: Second line of the card: the artifact, condition or expectation the source states next to the step. Absent when the source offers nothing short and authored — never synthesised.

lane.description: Who performs the step. Orthogonal to `type`; drives the swimlane the card is drawn in.

phase.description: The heading that names the stage this node belongs to (`Phase 2：UAT vs PROD 工单对齐`). Absent when no enclosing heading names a stage.

text.description: Readable body for the UI, newlines collapsed, truncated.

raw.description: The exact source lines. An edit is only safe against this, not against `text`.

when.description: The guard, as the author wrote it.

to.description: Target node id, when one could be named. Absent means unresolved, which the node flags.

confidence.description: The constant attached to the rule in `rule`, NOT a probability. `paragraph` always scores 0.65, so thirteen nodes reading 65% means thirteen paragraphs, not thirteen confident guesses. The UI labels it 规则 for this reason.

rule.description: Which classification rule produced this node (`paragraph`, `table-of-modes`, `pinned-marker`, …), so the score beside it can be explained.

when.description: The guard, for a branch edge.
